participation.context: Named Wednesday's salt, paid the sixpence, left Gib on the Ovid, and promised to be in close on nine.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Turned the glass twice, said he would be brief, and kept Wednesday's reading for Wednesday.
participation.name: Master Josias Thwaite

participation.context: Carried the heel of the loaf, took the sixpence, refused to salt the house early, and told the stair to expect him by nine.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Asked which hunger was hers, and whether to lay a trencher.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Sat three rows ahead and did not speak.
participation.name: Sir John Spencer

story.body: You took three days as the time to the ashes. You paid sixpence for firing and washing. You left the loaf at a penny and a finger short. You did not ask the house to begin the fast early. You said you would be in close on nine.

title: Heard that Ash Wednesday was three days off
